translation: Bestowing mercy upon all souls, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya Mahāprabhu descends with His associates and abode.
To distribute the most rare form of divine love, He teaches surrender, which is the life of the devotees:
Humility, self-submission, embracing the Lord’s guardianship, maintaining the faith that Kṛṣṇa will certainly protect me,
Commitment to engage only in activities that are favourable to devotion, and promising to reject any disposition unfavourable to devotion,
The divine son of Nanda hears the prayers of those who surrender in this six-fold way.
Bhakti Vinod places a straw between his teeth and falls before Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Sanātan, grasping their feet.

text: kā̐diyā kā̐diyā bale, āmi ta’ adhama
translation: Crying and crying, he prays, “I am so fallen! Please teach me surrender and uplift me.”
